options.title: OPTIONS

hint.navigation: Tab / Arrows: navigate    Left / Right: adjust    Enter: select    Esc: back

desc.volume: Overall loudness. Scales music and sound effects together.
desc.theme: Color scheme for the interface and the night sky. Applies immediately.
desc.titleFont: Font used for the game's title. Applies immediately.
desc.customCursor: Replaces your system pointer with the game's own cursor. Applies immediately.
desc.reducedMotion: Calms the background animation: shooting stars, drifting nebula, twinkling sky, and the title's color cycling. Applies immediately.
desc.display: Which monitor the game window opens on.
desc.resolution: Window size, or the output resolution in exclusive fullscreen.
desc.msaa: Smooths jagged edges. Higher settings cost more performance.
desc.displayMode: Windowed, borderless fullscreen, or exclusive fullscreen.
desc.vsync: Matches the frame rate to your monitor to stop tearing.
desc.uncapFps: Removes the engine's internal frame rate cap. VSync above still limits frames unless it's off too. Applies immediately.
desc.showNebula: Shows the drifting nebula on the main menu.
desc.shareStats: Shares star-pop counts and a random installation ID for aggregate statistics and the online player count. Only these values are sent.
desc.apply: Applies all pending graphics changes, including changes made on another tab.

options.pendingGraphics: Graphics changes waiting to be applied

note.adjusted: Resolution adjusted to an available size.
note.vsyncOn: VSync is currently limiting the frame rate.
note.vsyncPending: VSync also has an unapplied change.

error.failed: Could not apply graphics settings. The previous settings have been restored.
error.recovery: The previous display mode was unavailable. A windowed mode is active; your last confirmed settings are still saved.
error.restoreFailed: The display could not be restored. Your last confirmed settings are still saved. Close and restart the game to retry.
error.saveFailed: Could not save the graphics settings. The previous settings will be restored.

options.adjustedGraphics: The display adjusted the requested settings. Review the active values below before keeping them.
